description: Write an Amazon-style PR-FAQ (mock press release + FAQ) to pressure-test a product idea customer-first and kill weak ideas on paper. Use when someone says "write a PR-FAQ", "PRFAQ", "press release", "working backwards", "start from the customer", "draft the launch announcement", "is this idea clear enough to build", or has a fuzzy idea and wants clarity on what and why. NOT for testing risky assumptions with experiments (product-discovery) or build plans (shaping-work / write-plan).
